title: 光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統
titleEn: Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems
subcategoryTitle: 光頻標準、慣性感測與干涉量測
subcategoryTitleEn: Optical frequency standards, inertial sensing and interferometric metrology
summary: 以 ⁸⁷Sr 光晶格鐘為對象，從品質因數與艾倫偏差 σ_y(τ) ∝ 1/(Q·SNR·√τ) 出發，建置原子冷卻與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格、超高真空腔與放氣預算、698 nm 鐘雷射與 ULE 腔，再量化黑體輻射、晶格光位移與密度位移，最後以光纖雜訊消除、鐘比對與系統不確定度表完成可交接的光鐘工程。
summaryEn: Using the ⁸⁷Sr optical lattice clock as the object, this course starts from the quality factor and the Allan deviation σ_y(τ) ∝ 1/(Q·SNR·√τ), builds atom cooling and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice, the ultrahigh-vacuum chamber with its outgassing budget, the 698 nm clock laser with its ULE cavity, then quantifies blackbody, lattice light and density shifts, and closes with fibre-noise cancellation, clock comparison and a systematic-uncertainty table for a hand-over-ready optical clock.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限」與「原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock" and "Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」如何決定光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation” determines the key performance of “Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光學原子鐘用一束窄線寬雷射去探測原子中一條極窄的躍遷（⁸⁷Sr 的 ¹S₀–³P₀，698 nm，429.228 THz，自然線寬約 1 mHz），把原子的激發機率當作誤差訊號，週期性地修正雷射頻率，再用頻率梳把光頻除頻到可計數的射頻。它比銫鐘好的原因是品質因數 Q = ν/Δν 高了約五個數量級：光頻 4×10¹⁴ Hz 對微波 9×10⁹ Hz。穩定度以艾倫偏差描述，σ_y(τ) ≈ (1/(π·Q·SNR))·√(T_c/τ)，其中 SNR 由原子數的量子投影雜訊限制（SNR = √N），T_c 是包含裝載與探測的鐘週期。系統邊界因此是：真空中一團冷原子、一支鐘雷射、一套冷卻與晶格雷射、以及把光頻帶出去的頻率梳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An optical atomic clock probes an extremely narrow transition in an atom (for ⁸⁷Sr the ¹S₀–³P₀ line at 698 nm, 429.228 THz, natural linewidth about 1 mHz) with a narrow-linewidth laser, uses the excitation probability as an error signal to correct the laser frequency periodically, and divides the optical frequency down to countable radio frequency with a frequency comb. It beats a caesium clock because the quality factor Q = ν/Δν is about five orders higher: 4×10¹⁴ Hz optical against 9×10⁹ Hz microwave. Stability is described by the Allan deviation σ_y(τ) ≈ (1/(π·Q·SNR))·√(T_c/τ), where SNR is limited by quantum projection noise of the atom number (SNR = √N) and T_c is the clock cycle including loading and probing. The system boundary is therefore a cloud of cold atoms in vacuum, a clock laser, a set of cooling and lattice lasers, and a comb that carries the optical frequency out. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 ν = 429.228 THz、探測線寬 Δν = 1 Hz（約 0.8 s 的 Rabi 脈衝），Q = 4.3×10¹⁴；N = 1000 個原子，SNR = √1000 = 31.6；T_c = 1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With ν = 429.228 THz and a probe linewidth Δν = 1 Hz (a Rabi pulse of about 0.8 s), Q = 4.3×10¹⁴; with N = 1000 atoms, SNR = √1000 = 31.6; T_c = 1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光鐘比銫鐘準是因為雷射比微波源更穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Optical clocks beat caesium clocks because lasers are more stable than microwave sources." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限
knowledge.titleEn: System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock
knowledge.text: 光學原子鐘用一束窄線寬雷射去探測原子中一條極窄的躍遷（⁸⁷Sr 的 ¹S₀–³P₀，698 nm，429.228 THz，自然線寬約 1 mHz），把原子的激發機率當作誤差訊號，週期性地修正雷射頻率，再用頻率梳把光頻除頻到可計數的射頻。它比銫鐘好的原因是品質因數 Q = ν/Δν 高了約五個數量級：光頻 4×10¹⁴ Hz 對微波 9×10⁹ Hz。
knowledge.textEn: An optical atomic clock probes an extremely narrow transition in an atom (for ⁸⁷Sr the ¹S₀–³P₀ line at 698 nm, 429.228 THz, natural linewidth about 1 mHz) with a narrow-linewidth laser, uses the excitation probability as an error signal to correct the laser frequency periodically, and divides the optical frequency down to countable radio frequency with a frequency comb. It beats a caesium clock because the quality factor Q = ν/Δν is about five orders higher: 4×10¹⁴ Hz optical against 9×10⁹ Hz microwave.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光鐘比銫鐘準是因為雷射比微波源更穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Optical clocks beat caesium clocks because lasers are more stable than microwave sources. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock" is correct?
options: 光鐘比銫鐘準是因為雷射比微波源更穩定。
光學原子鐘用一束窄線寬雷射去探測原子中一條極窄的躍遷（⁸⁷Sr 的 ¹S₀–³P₀，698 nm，429.228 THz，自然線寬約 1 mHz），把原子的激發機率當作誤差訊號，週期性地修正雷射頻率，再用頻率梳把光頻除頻到可計數的射頻。
只要原子夠冷，不用晶格也能用秒級探測得到 Hz 級線寬。
optionsEn: Optical clocks beat caesium clocks because lasers are more stable than microwave sources.

An optical atomic clock probes an extremely narrow transition in an atom (for ⁸⁷Sr the ¹S₀–³P₀ line at 698 nm, 429.228 THz, natural linewidth about 1 mHz) with a narrow-linewidth laser, uses the excitation probability as an error signal to correct the laser frequency periodically, and divides the optical frequency down to countable radio frequency with a frequency comb.
Cold enough atoms give hertz-level linewidths with second-long probes even without a lattice.
quiz.explanation: 光學原子鐘用一束窄線寬雷射去探測原子中一條極窄的躍遷（⁸⁷Sr 的 ¹S₀–³P₀，698 nm，429.228 THz，自然線寬約 1 mHz），把原子的激發機率當作誤差訊號，週期性地修正雷射頻率，再用頻率梳把光頻除頻到可計數的射頻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An optical atomic clock probes an extremely narrow transition in an atom (for ⁸⁷Sr the ¹S₀–³P₀ line at 698 nm, 429.228 THz, natural linewidth about 1 mHz) with a narrow-linewidth laser, uses the excitation probability as an error signal to correct the laser frequency periodically, and divides the optical frequency down to countable radio frequency with a frequency comb. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 ν = 429.228 THz、探測線寬 Δν = 1 Hz（約 0.8 s 的 Rabi 脈衝），Q = 4.3×10¹⁴；N = 1000 個原子，SNR = √1000 = 31.6；T_c = 1.5 s。σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷，這是量子投影雜訊極限；要平均到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 τ = (2.9×10⁻¹⁷/10⁻¹⁸)² ≈ 830 s。實際上鐘雷射雜訊與迪克效應常把 1 s 穩定度拉到 2×10⁻¹⁶，此時到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 小時。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With ν = 429.228 THz and a probe linewidth Δν = 1 Hz (a Rabi pulse of about 0.8 s), Q = 4.3×10¹⁴; with N = 1000 atoms, SNR = √1000 = 31.6; T_c = 1.5 s. Then σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷, the quantum-projection-noise limit; averaging to 1×10⁻¹⁸ takes τ = (2.9×10⁻¹⁷/10⁻¹⁸)² ≈ 830 s. In practice clock-laser noise and the Dick effect often raise the 1 s stability to 2×10⁻¹⁶, and reaching 1×10⁻¹⁸ then takes 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 hours. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩次交錯探測（鐘躍遷線形兩側的半高點）記錄激發機率的逐週期起伏，計算其標準差並與 1/(2√N) 的量子投影雜訊比較；再用頻率梳把鐘雷射與第二台鐘或超穩雷射拍頻計數，畫出艾倫偏差，確認在 1–100 s 區間斜率為 −1/2，且 1 s 的值落在 QPN 與鐘雷射限制之間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the cycle-to-cycle fluctuation of the excitation probability from two interleaved probes at the half-maximum points of the clock line, compute its standard deviation and compare with the 1/(2√N) quantum-projection noise; then count the beat between the clock laser and a second clock or ultrastable laser through the comb, plot the Allan deviation, and confirm a −1/2 slope from 1 to 100 s with the 1 s value lying between the QPN and clock-laser limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 取 ν = 429.228 THz、探測線寬 Δν = 1 Hz（約 0.8 s 的 Rabi 脈衝），Q = 4.3×10¹⁴；N = 1000 個原子，SNR = √1000 = 31.6；T_c = 1.5 s。σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷，這是量子投影雜訊極限；要平均到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 τ = (2.9×10⁻¹⁷/10⁻¹⁸)² ≈ 830 s。實際上鐘雷射雜訊與迪克效應常把 1 s 穩定度拉到 2×10⁻¹⁶，此時到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 小時。
knowledge.textEn: With ν = 429.228 THz and a probe linewidth Δν = 1 Hz (a Rabi pulse of about 0.8 s), Q = 4.3×10¹⁴; with N = 1000 atoms, SNR = √1000 = 31.6; T_c = 1.5 s. Then σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷, the quantum-projection-noise limit; averaging to 1×10⁻¹⁸ takes τ = (2.9×10⁻¹⁷/10⁻¹⁸)² ≈ 830 s. In practice clock-laser noise and the Dick effect often raise the 1 s stability to 2×10⁻¹⁶, and reaching 1×10⁻¹⁸ then takes 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 hours.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock", which statement holds?
options: 鐘雷射的線寬只取決於二極體雷射本身的品質。
準確度與穩定度是同一件事，艾倫偏差小就代表鐘準。
取 ν = 429.228 THz、探測線寬 Δν = 1 Hz（約 0.8 s 的 Rabi 脈衝），Q = 4.3×10¹⁴。
optionsEn: The clock laser's linewidth depends only on the quality of the diode laser itself.
Accuracy and stability are the same thing, so a small Allan deviation means the clock is accurate.
With ν = 429.228 THz and a probe linewidth Δν = 1 Hz (a Rabi pulse of about 0.8 s), Q = 4.3×10¹⁴; with N = 1000 atoms, SNR = √1000 = 31.6; T_c = 1.5 s.
quiz.explanation: 取 ν = 429.228 THz、探測線寬 Δν = 1 Hz（約 0.8 s 的 Rabi 脈衝），Q = 4.3×10¹⁴；N = 1000 個原子，SNR = √1000 = 31.6；T_c = 1.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With ν = 429.228 THz and a probe linewidth Δν = 1 Hz (a Rabi pulse of about 0.8 s), Q = 4.3×10¹⁴; with N = 1000 atoms, SNR = √1000 = 31.6; T_c = 1.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以兩次交錯探測（鐘躍遷線形兩側的半高點）記錄激發機率的逐週期起伏，計算其標準差並與 1/(2√N) 的量子投影雜訊比較；再用頻率梳把鐘雷射與第二台鐘或超穩雷射拍頻計數，畫出艾倫偏差，確認在 1–100 s 區間斜率為 −1/2，且 1 s 的值落在 QPN 與鐘雷射限制之間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the cycle-to-cycle fluctuation of the excitation probability from two interleaved probes at the half-maximum points of the clock line, compute its standard deviation and compare with the 1/(2√N) quantum-projection noise; then count the beat between the clock laser and a second clock or ultrastable laser through the comb, plot the Allan deviation, and confirm a −1/2 slope from 1 to 100 s with the 1 s value lying between the QPN and clock-laser limits. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了提高 SNR 把原子數增加到 10⁵ 卻沒有擴大晶格體積，密度位移升到 10⁻¹⁶ 等級且隨裝載起伏，穩定度看似變好，準確度卻變差一個數量級。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the atom number to 10⁵ for SNR without enlarging the lattice volume pushes the density shift to the 10⁻¹⁶ level and makes it fluctuate with loading; stability looks better while accuracy worsens by an order of magnitude.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以兩次交錯探測（鐘躍遷線形兩側的半高點）記錄激發機率的逐週期起伏，計算其標準差並與 1/(2√N) 的量子投影雜訊比較；再用頻率梳把鐘雷射與第二台鐘或超穩雷射拍頻計數，畫出艾倫偏差，確認在 1–100 s 區間斜率為 −1/2，且 1 s 的值落在 QPN 與鐘雷射限制之間。
knowledge.textEn: Record the cycle-to-cycle fluctuation of the excitation probability from two interleaved probes at the half-maximum points of the clock line, compute its standard deviation and compare with the 1/(2√N) quantum-projection noise; then count the beat between the clock laser and a second clock or ultrastable laser through the comb, plot the Allan deviation, and confirm a −1/2 slope from 1 to 100 s with the 1 s value lying between the QPN and clock-laser limits.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock"?
options: 以兩次交錯探測（鐘躍遷線形兩側的半高點）記錄激發機率的逐週期起伏，計算其標準差並與 1/(2√N) 的量子投影雜訊比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
單模光纖只是把光從 A 點送到 B 點，不會改變光的頻率。
optionsEn: Record the cycle-to-cycle fluctuation of the excitation probability from two interleaved probes at the half-maximum points of the clock line, compute its standard deviation and compare with the 1/(2√N) quantum-projection noise.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A single-mode fibre merely moves light from A to B and cannot change its frequency.
quiz.explanation: 以兩次交錯探測（鐘躍遷線形兩側的半高點）記錄激發機率的逐週期起伏，計算其標準差並與 1/(2√N) 的量子投影雜訊比較；再用頻率梳把鐘雷射與第二台鐘或超穩雷射拍頻計數，畫出艾倫偏差，確認在 1–100 s 區間斜率為 −1/2，且 1 s 的值落在 QPN 與鐘雷射限制之間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record the cycle-to-cycle fluctuation of the excitation probability from two interleaved probes at the half-maximum points of the clock line, compute its standard deviation and compare with the 1/(2√N) quantum-projection noise; then count the beat between the clock laser and a second clock or ultrastable laser through the comb, plot the Allan deviation, and confirm a −1/2 slope from 1 to 100 s with the 1 s value lying between the QPN and clock-laser limits. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了提高 SNR 把原子數增加到 10⁵ 卻沒有擴大晶格體積，密度位移升到 10⁻¹⁶ 等級且隨裝載起伏，穩定度看似變好，準確度卻變差一個數量級。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the atom number to 10⁵ for SNR without enlarging the lattice volume pushes the density shift to the 10⁻¹⁶ level and makes it fluctuate with loading; stability looks better while accuracy worsens by an order of magnitude. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：系統邊界因此是：真空中一團冷原子、一支鐘雷射、一套冷卻與晶格雷射、以及把光頻帶出去的頻率梳。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system boundary is therefore a cloud of cold atoms in vacuum, a clock laser, a set of cooling and lattice lasers, and a comb that carries the optical frequency out.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光鐘比銫鐘準是因為雷射比微波源更穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Optical clocks beat caesium clocks because lasers are more stable than microwave sources." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格」如何決定光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice” determines the key performance of “Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍶原子先在 461 nm 的 ¹S₀–¹P₁ 寬線（Γ = 2π×32 MHz）磁光阱中被減速冷卻到毫開爾文，再轉到 689 nm 的 ¹S₀–³P₁ 窄線（Γ = 2π×7.5 kHz）磁光阱冷到微開爾文，然後裝進 813 nm 的一維光晶格。813 nm 是魔術波長：鐘躍遷上下能階的交流極化率相等，晶格光對鐘頻率的一階位移為零。晶格使原子沿探測方向被侷限在遠小於 698 nm 的範圍內（蘭姆—迪克區），都卜勒與反衝位移消失，才能以秒級的探測時間看到 Hz 級的線寬。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strontium atoms are first slowed and cooled to millikelvin in a magneto-optical trap on the broad 461 nm ¹S₀–¹P₁ line (Γ = 2π×32 MHz), then transferred to a MOT on the narrow 689 nm ¹S₀–³P₁ line (Γ = 2π×7.5 kHz) to reach microkelvin, and finally loaded into a one-dimensional optical lattice at 813 nm. 813 nm is the magic wavelength: the AC polarizabilities of the two clock states are equal, so the first-order lattice light shift of the clock frequency vanishes. The lattice confines the atoms along the probe direction to far less than 698 nm (the Lamb–Dicke regime), eliminating Doppler and recoil shifts so that second-long probes can reveal hertz-level linewidths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：都卜勒極限 T_D = ħΓ/(2k_B)：461 nm 藍阱 T_D = 1.055×10⁻³⁴×2π×32×10⁶/(2×1.381×10⁻²³) = 0.77 mK；689 nm 紅阱 T_D = 180 nK，但反衝極限 T_r = ħ²k²/(m·k_B) = 464 nK（m = 86.9 u），所以紅阱實際落在約 1 µK。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Doppler limit is T_D = ħΓ/(2k_B): for the 461 nm blue MOT T_D = 1.055×10⁻³⁴×2π×32×10⁶/(2×1.381×10⁻²³) = 0.77 mK; for the 689 nm red MOT T_D = 180 nK, but the recoil limit T_r = ħ²k²/(m·k_B) = 464 nK (m = 86.9 u), so the red MOT actually reaches about 1 µK.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要原子夠冷，不用晶格也能用秒級探測得到 Hz 級線寬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cold enough atoms give hertz-level linewidths with second-long probes even without a lattice." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：都卜勒極限 T_D = ħΓ/(2k_B)：461 nm 藍阱 T_D = 1.055×10⁻³⁴×2π×32×10⁶/(2×1.381×10⁻²³) = 0.77 mK；689 nm 紅阱 T_D = 180 nK，但反衝極限 T_r = ħ²k²/(m·k_B) = 464 nK（m = 86.9 u），所以紅阱實際落在約 1 µK。813 nm 晶格的反衝能 E_r/h = 3.47 kHz（E_r/k_B = 167 nK）；井深 U = 50 E_r = 8.3 µK 時軸向囚禁頻率 ν_z = 2(E_r/h)·√(U/E_r) = 2×3.47×√50 ≈ 49 kHz，遠大於鐘躍遷線寬，滿足蘭姆—迪克條件。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Doppler limit is T_D = ħΓ/(2k_B): for the 461 nm blue MOT T_D = 1.055×10⁻³⁴×2π×32×10⁶/(2×1.381×10⁻²³) = 0.77 mK; for the 689 nm red MOT T_D = 180 nK, but the recoil limit T_r = ħ²k²/(m·k_B) = 464 nK (m = 86.9 u), so the red MOT actually reaches about 1 µK. The 813 nm lattice recoil energy is E_r/h = 3.47 kHz (E_r/k_B = 167 nK); at a depth U = 50 E_r = 8.3 µK the axial trap frequency is ν_z = 2(E_r/h)·√(U/E_r) = 2×3.47×√50 ≈ 49 kHz, far above the clock linewidth, satisfying the Lamb–Dicke condition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以飛行時間法量紅阱釋放後原子雲的膨脹速率得到溫度，確認約 1 µK；以鐘雷射掃描晶格中的運動邊帶，量得藍、紅邊帶與載波的頻率間隔即為 ν_z，與 49 kHz 的估計比較，並由邊帶振幅比推算平均振動量子數；調整晶格功率確認 ν_z 隨 √U 變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the temperature by time-of-flight expansion of the cloud released from the red MOT, confirming about 1 µK; scan the clock laser across the motional sidebands in the lattice, read the blue- and red-sideband spacing from the carrier as ν_z, compare with the 49 kHz estimate and infer the mean vibrational quantum number from the sideband amplitude ratio; vary the lattice power and confirm that ν_z scales with √U.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以飛行時間法量紅阱釋放後原子雲的膨脹速率得到溫度，確認約 1 µK；以鐘雷射掃描晶格中的運動邊帶，量得藍、紅邊帶與載波的頻率間隔即為 ν_z，與 49 kHz 的估計比較，並由邊帶振幅比推算平均振動量子數；調整晶格功率確認 ν_z 隨 √U 變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the temperature by time-of-flight expansion of the cloud released from the red MOT, confirming about 1 µK; scan the clock laser across the motional sidebands in the lattice, read the blue- and red-sideband spacing from the carrier as ν_z, compare with the 49 kHz estimate and infer the mean vibrational quantum number from the sideband amplitude ratio; vary the lattice power and confirm that ν_z scales with √U. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：晶格光偏離魔術波長 0.1 nm（約 45 GHz）時，上下能階極化率不再相等，鐘頻率隨晶格功率線性漂移，每一次功率起伏都直接變成頻率誤差，準確度卡在 10⁻¹⁵。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With the lattice light 0.1 nm (about 45 GHz) off the magic wavelength the two polarizabilities no longer match, the clock frequency drifts linearly with lattice power, every power fluctuation becomes a frequency error and accuracy stalls at 10⁻¹⁵.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以飛行時間法量紅阱釋放後原子雲的膨脹速率得到溫度，確認約 1 µK；以鐘雷射掃描晶格中的運動邊帶，量得藍、紅邊帶與載波的頻率間隔即為 ν_z，與 49 kHz 的估計比較，並由邊帶振幅比推算平均振動量子數；調整晶格功率確認 ν_z 隨 √U 變化。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the temperature by time-of-flight expansion of the cloud released from the red MOT, confirming about 1 µK; scan the clock laser across the motional sidebands in the lattice, read the blue- and red-sideband spacing from the carrier as ν_z, compare with the 49 kHz estimate and infer the mean vibrational quantum number from the sideband amplitude ratio; vary the lattice power and confirm that ν_z scales with √U.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以飛行時間法量紅阱釋放後原子雲的膨脹速率得到溫度，確認約 1 µK。
一台鐘的系統不確定度表做完一次，就能永久代表它的準確度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the temperature by time-of-flight expansion of the cloud released from the red MOT, confirming about 1 µK.
Once a clock's systematic table is completed, it represents the clock's accuracy permanently.
quiz.explanation: 以飛行時間法量紅阱釋放後原子雲的膨脹速率得到溫度，確認約 1 µK；以鐘雷射掃描晶格中的運動邊帶，量得藍、紅邊帶與載波的頻率間隔即為 ν_z，與 49 kHz 的估計比較，並由邊帶振幅比推算平均振動量子數；調整晶格功率確認 ν_z 隨 √U 變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the temperature by time-of-flight expansion of the cloud released from the red MOT, confirming about 1 µK; scan the clock laser across the motional sidebands in the lattice, read the blue- and red-sideband spacing from the carrier as ν_z, compare with the 49 kHz estimate and infer the mean vibrational quantum number from the sideband amplitude ratio; vary the lattice power and confirm that ν_z scales with √U. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 晶格光偏離魔術波長 0.1 nm（約 45 GHz）時，上下能階極化率不再相等，鐘頻率隨晶格功率線性漂移，每一次功率起伏都直接變成頻率誤差，準確度卡在 10⁻¹⁵。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With the lattice light 0.1 nm (about 45 GHz) off the magic wavelength the two polarizabilities no longer match, the clock frequency drifts linearly with lattice power, every power fluctuation becomes a frequency error and accuracy stalls at 10⁻¹⁵. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：晶格使原子沿探測方向被侷限在遠小於 698 nm 的範圍內（蘭姆—迪克區），都卜勒與反衝位移消失，才能以秒級的探測時間看到 Hz 級的線寬。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lattice confines the atoms along the probe direction to far less than 698 nm (the Lamb–Dicke regime), eliminating Doppler and recoil shifts so that second-long probes can reveal hertz-level linewidths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要原子夠冷，不用晶格也能用秒級探測得到 Hz 級線寬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cold enough atoms give hertz-level linewidths with second-long probes even without a lattice." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 晶格光偏離魔術波長 0.1 nm（約 45 GHz）時，上下能階極化率不再相等，鐘頻率隨晶格功率線性漂移，每一次功率起伏都直接變成頻率誤差，準確度卡在 10⁻¹⁵。
knowledge.textEn: With the lattice light 0.1 nm (about 45 GHz) off the magic wavelength the two polarizabilities no longer match, the clock frequency drifts linearly with lattice power, every power fluctuation becomes a frequency error and accuracy stalls at 10⁻¹⁵.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
真空只要「夠低」讓原子不被碰掉就好，對鐘的準確度沒有直接影響。
晶格光偏離魔術波長 0.1 nm（約 45 GHz）時，上下能階極化率不再相等，鐘頻率隨晶格功率線性漂移，每一次功率起伏都直接變成頻率誤差，準確度卡在 10⁻¹⁵。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Vacuum only needs to be low enough to keep atoms from being knocked out and has no direct effect on clock accuracy.

With the lattice light 0.1 nm (about 45 GHz) off the magic wavelength the two polarizabilities no longer match, the clock frequency drifts linearly with lattice power, every power fluctuation becomes a frequency error and accuracy stalls at 10⁻¹⁵.
quiz.explanation: 晶格光偏離魔術波長 0.1 nm（約 45 GHz）時，上下能階極化率不再相等，鐘頻率隨晶格功率線性漂移，每一次功率起伏都直接變成頻率誤差，準確度卡在 10⁻¹⁵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With the lattice light 0.1 nm (about 45 GHz) off the magic wavelength the two polarizabilities no longer match, the clock frequency drifts linearly with lattice power, every power fluctuation becomes a frequency error and accuracy stalls at 10⁻¹⁵. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
